result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Vendor defends and indemnifies Customer and its Affiliates against third-party IP, legal-compliance, Vendor-caused data-breach, and gross-negligence/wilful-misconduct claims; Customer’s indemnity is limited to Customer-provided content and breach of law; and customary notice, defence-control, cooperation, exclusions, and infringement remedies are included. The additions also resolve the existing Section 20.5 cross-references without altering unrelated terms. Drafting is professional, with only a minor ambiguity in Section 20.5’s reference to “neither remedy” after listing three remedial options.
